name: hedgehog-bootstrap-deepseek-harness-core
tagline_zh: 调教技能的技能：hedgehog-bootstrap-deepseek-harness-core。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use once, at the start of a new Hedgehog project on the deepseek-harness core, to land the pre-verified DSH/Cordis plugin workspace and verify it's green. Runs as the only move of the `bootstrap` agent on this core — there are no add-on steps, unlike full-stack-app. Invoked automatically by `planner` after Confirm & Lock.
